values.value: one pair purchased equals one pair donated
values.text: Bombas runs a giving model where one pair purchased equals one pair donated.

Bombas runs on a One Purchased = One Donated model: for every item purchased, the company donates a clothing item, socks, underwear, or t-shirts, the three most-requested items at homeless shelters, to a Giving Partner serving people experiencing homelessness or housing insecurity.
